laws.rule: An area extending 20 km from the country's northern border, including the border areas of Hafr Al-Batin and Khafji in the Eastern Province, is an 'out-of-bounds zone'. Entering without permission can bring a prison sentence of up to 30 months and a fine of SAR 25,000. Cross only at official land border crossings.
